name: mixed-value-field
title: Mixed Value Field
description: Bulk-edit field that shows "Mixed (3 values)" with the distribution instead of a blank or the first record's value, leaves each record alone unless you pick a value, and reads back exactly what saving changes, counting only records that actually change.

meta.summary: In a bulk edit, shows "Mixed (3 values)" with the spread instead of a blank, so saving doesn't silently overwrite every record.
catches: Mixed values hidden behind a blank or the first record's value
Saving overwrites records nobody meant to touch: nothing changes unless a value is picked
Count of records that would really change, skipping those that already match
Clearing a field on every record: explicit Clear button
limits: Works on one field at a time
The save itself is yours; it only reports the planned change
a11y: Visible label; the control is described by the readback
Clear uses aria-pressed; Revert is a button
The distribution bar is aria-hidden and summarised in text
